t: What Health Facility Capacity Database Is All About
title: What Health Facility Capacity Database Is All About
description: Health capacity is beds, staff, and equipment with the skills to use them: ICU beds per 100,000 range from ~30 (US) to under 1 (many low-income countries); ventilators need respiratory therapists, not just machines. COVID showed capacity is dynamic — surge plans convert wards, cancel electives, and retrain staff. The constraint is usually staff, not steel. This database is the complete facility capacity record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
